prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: I am directly coming (A) / from the administrative office (B) / to clear all your pending doubts. (C) / No Error (D)
options: to clear all your pending doubts.
explanation: With verbs of motion, 'direct/directly' follows the verb rather than splitting the continuous form. Correct: 'I am coming directly from the administrative office'.
